topics.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时
rules: 一般现在时：习惯、事实、时刻表；常与 always/often/every day 连用。
现在进行时：此刻/现阶段进行；有时表将来（位移动词 go/come/leave）。
状态动词（know/believe/own）一般不用进行时。
examples: Water boils at 100°C.
She is writing her term paper now.
The train leaves at 8 tomorrow.

questions.stem: Look! The children ___ football on the playground.
questions.explain: Look! 提示此刻正在进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: He usually ___ to work by subway.
questions.explain: usually + 一般现在时；主语三单加 s。

questions.stem: I ___ what you mean, but I disagree.
questions.explain: know 为状态动词，不用进行时。

questions.stem: The plane ___ at 6 a.m. tomorrow morning.
questions.explain: 时刻表常用一般现在时表将来。

questions.stem: She ___ in this company these days.
questions.explain: these days 阶段性 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.explain: 客观事实。

questions.stem: Listen! Someone ___ the piano.
questions.explain: Listen! 进行时。

topics.title: 一般过去时与现在完成时
rules: 一般过去时：明确过去时间（yesterday/last year/in 2020）。
现在完成时：过去动作对现在有影响；或从过去持续到现在（since/for）。
already/yet/ever/never/just 常配现在完成时。
examples: I visited Beijing last summer.
I have lived here since 2018.
Have you ever been abroad?

questions.stem: I ___ my keys. I can't open the door now.
questions.explain: 强调现在结果 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: He ___ in 2010 and has worked there ever since.
questions.explain: 明确过去时间 in 2010 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: We ___ each other since primary school.
questions.explain: since + 过去起点 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: She has already ___ the report.
questions.explain: has + 过去分词 finished。

questions.stem: When I ___ home, it was raining.
questions.explain: when + 过去时间点，主句过去时。

questions.stem: This is the best movie I ___ seen.
questions.explain: 固定：the best … I have ever seen。

questions.stem: I ___ this film twice.
questions.explain: twice + 完成时。

questions.stem: When ___ you ___ to China?
questions.explain: 过去时间疑问。

topics.title: 过去完成时与将来时
rules: 过去完成时：过去的过去（by + 过去时间 / before / after / when）。
will + do / be going to：将来；be about to：即将。
现在进行时 / 一般现在时也可表将来（计划、时刻表）。
examples: By 2020, they had built three bridges.
I will call you tonight.
We are leaving for Shanghai tomorrow.

questions.stem: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
questions.explain: 过去的过去 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: He told me he ___ the task already.
questions.explain: told 过去；finish 更早 → had finished。

questions.stem: Look at the dark clouds — it ___ rain.
questions.explain: 有迹象的推测用 be going to。

questions.stem: The conference ___ next Monday.
questions.explain: 日程表可用一般现在时表将来。

topics.title: 现在完成进行时与语态结合
rules: have/has been doing：从过去持续到现在，且可能继续。
与现在完成时区别：更强调动作的持续与过程。
常与 since/for/all morning 等连用。
examples: I have been reading for two hours.
They have been discussing the issue since Monday.

questions.stem: She ___ English for six years and is still learning.
questions.explain: 持续至今且可能继续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: My eyes are tired — I ___ at the screen all day.
questions.explain: all day + 疲劳后果 → have been looking。

questions.stem: How many books ___ so far this term?
questions.explain: so far + 数量结果 → 现在完成时更自然。

topics.title: 被动语态基本结构
rules: 结构：be + 过去分词（+ by 短语）。
时态体现在 be 上：is done / was done / has been done / will be done。
不及物动词无被动；happen/take place/occur 等。
examples: The bridge was built in 1990.
English is spoken worldwide.

questions.stem: The report ___ by the team last week.
questions.explain: last week + 被动 → was written。

questions.stem: These products ___ to many countries.
questions.explain: 产品被出口 → are exported。

questions.stem: The meeting ___ until next Friday.
questions.explain: 会议被推迟 → will be put off。

questions.stem: Great changes ___ in our city since 2015.
questions.explain: take place 无被动。

questions.stem: Rome ___ in a day.
questions.explain: 谚语被动。

questions.stem: All the preparations ___ by the end of last week.
questions.explain: by + 过去 → 过去完成被动。

topics.title: 含情态动词与双宾语的被动
rules: 情态动词被动：must/can/should + be + done。
双宾语被动：give sb sth → sb be given sth / sth be given to sb。
短语动词被动：look after → be looked after。
examples: The work must be finished today.
He was given a prize. / A prize was given to him.

questions.stem: This problem ___ at tomorrow's meeting.
questions.explain: should + be discussed。

questions.stem: A scholarship ___ to the top student.
questions.explain: 被动 + 过去时间语境 → was offered。

questions.stem: The children ___ by their grandparents in the village.
questions.explain: look after 的被动：are looked after。

topics.title: 主动表被动与 get-passive
rules: want/need/require + doing：主动形式表被动含义。
get + done：口语化被动（get hurt/get lost）。
感官系动词 feel/sound + adj：无被动。
examples: The car needs repairing.
He got injured in the match.

questions.stem: The flowers need ___ every day.
questions.explain: need doing = need to be done。

questions.stem: She ___ lost in the strange city.
questions.explain: get lost 较常见。

questions.stem: The idea sounds ___ to me.
questions.explain: sound + 形容词，主动表状态。

topics.title: if 条件句虚拟
rules: 与现在事实相反：if + 过去式（be 用 were），主句 would/could/might + do。
与过去事实相反：if + had done，主句 would have done。
与将来可能相反：if + 过去式 / were to / should + do。
examples: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If he had studied harder, he would have passed.

questions.stem: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
questions.explain: 虚拟现在：be 统一用 were。

questions.stem: If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.
questions.explain: 过去虚拟：if had done → would have done。

questions.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, we would cancel the picnic.
questions.explain: 将来虚拟：if + 过去式。

questions.stem: If they had warned us, we ___ the loss.
questions.explain: 与过去相反主句 would have done。

questions.stem: If I had money, I ___ a car.
questions.explain: 现在虚拟主句 would do。

questions.stem: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explain: 真理用一般现在时，非虚拟。

topics.title: wish / as if / if only
rules: wish + 过去式：现在不能实现的愿望。
wish + 过去完成时：对过去的遗憾。
as if / if only 时态后退规则同 wish。
examples: I wish I knew the answer.
I wish I had taken your advice.

questions.stem: I wish I ___ more time to travel.
questions.explain: 对现在的愿望 → 过去式 had。

questions.stem: He talks as if he ___ everything.
questions.explain: as if 虚拟 → knew。

questions.stem: If only we ___ to the doctor earlier!
questions.explain: 对过去的懊悔 → had gone。

topics.title: suggest / demand 等从句虚拟
rules: suggest / advise / demand / require / insist / order + that + (should) + 动词原形。
suggest 作「暗示」时用正常时态。
It is essential / important / necessary that … 同规则。
examples: He suggested that the meeting (should) be postponed.
The look on his face suggested that he was angry.

questions.stem: The doctor recommended that he ___ smoking.
questions.explain: recommend that + (should) do。

questions.stem: It is essential that every student ___ the rules.
questions.explain: essential that + 原形。

questions.stem: Her pale face suggested that she ___ ill.
questions.explain: suggest「暗示」不用虚拟。

topics.title: 关系代词 who/whom/which/that
rules: who 指人（主/宾）；whom 宾格；which 指物。
that 人/物皆可；限制性从句常用。
关系词在从句中作成分，不可省略成分时才可省略宾格。
examples: The man who spoke is my uncle.
This is the book which I bought.

questions.stem: The girl ___ won the prize is my classmate.
questions.explain: 指人且作主语 → who。

questions.stem: I remember the day ___ we first met.
questions.explain: 先行词 day + 从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: The book ___ cover is red is mine.
questions.explain: 所属关系 → whose。

questions.stem: This is the factory ___ his father works.
questions.explain: 地点 + 不及物 work → where。

questions.stem: The reason ___ he was late is unknown.
questions.explain: reason + why。

questions.stem: Anyone ___ wants to join can sign up.
questions.explain: 指人主格 who。

topics.title: 介词 + 关系代词 / 限制性与非限制性
rules: prep + whom/which：介词前置时不用 that。
非限制性（逗号）不用 that，可指整个主句（as/which）。
as 正如…那样，位置更灵活。
examples: This is the house in which he lives.
He passed the exam, which surprised us.

questions.stem: The man ___ I talked is a professor.
questions.explain: talk to sb → to whom。

questions.stem: He failed again, ___ made his parents worried.
questions.explain: 非限制性指前面整句 → which。

questions.stem: ___ is known to all, the earth is round.
questions.explain: as is known to all 固定。

topics.title: 时间状语从句
rules: when/while/as/before/after/until/since/as soon as。
主句将来时，时间从句用一般现在时表将来。
while 强调同时进行；when 可接点或段。
examples: I will call you when I arrive.
While he was sleeping, someone knocked.

questions.stem: I'll tell him the news as soon as he ___ back.
questions.explain: 时间从句用一般现在时表将来。

questions.stem: ___ reading, he fell asleep.
questions.explain: while + 持续动作。

questions.stem: I didn't leave ___ he came back.
questions.explain: not until 直到…才。

topics.title: 条件 / 让步 / 原因 / 结果从句
rules: 条件：if / unless / as long as / provided that。
让步：although/though（不与 but 连用）/ even if / no matter what。
原因：because / since / as；结果：so…that / such…that。
examples: Although it was raining, we went out.
He spoke so fast that I couldn't follow.

questions.stem: ___ he is young, he knows a lot.
questions.explain: 让步：Although…

questions.stem: I will go ___ it rains or not.
questions.explain: whether…or not 固定。

questions.stem: He made ___ rapid progress that everyone was surprised.
questions.explain: so + adj + that。

questions.stem: You won't pass ___ you work harder.
questions.explain: unless = if not。

topics.title: 主语从句与宾语从句
rules: 主语从句：That he came surprised us. / It is clear that…
宾语从句：I think that… / 不知是否用 whether/if。
从句用陈述语序。
examples: That she left so early was strange.
I wonder whether he will come.

questions.stem: ___ he said at the meeting surprised everyone.
questions.explain: said 后缺宾语 → What。

questions.stem: I don't know ___ he will agree or not.
questions.explain: 与 or not 连用 → whether。

questions.stem: It is obvious ___ she has made a mistake.
questions.explain: 主语从句 that 不省略时常见。

topics.title: 表语从句与同位语从句
rules: 表语从句：The problem is that we lack time.
同位语从句：解释抽象名词（news/idea/fact/hope）的具体内容。
that 在同位语从句中不作成分，不可省略。
examples: The news that he won is true.
The reason is that he was ill.

questions.stem: The fact ___ he cheated shocked us.
questions.explain: fact 的同位语从句 → that。

questions.stem: This is ___ we differ from each other.
questions.explain: 表语从句：这就是分歧所在。

questions.stem: I have no idea ___ she has gone.
questions.explain: idea 的同位语，缺地点状语 → where。

topics.title: 不定式 vs 动名词作宾语
rules: 只接 to do：want/hope/decide/plan/agree/refuse。
只接 doing：enjoy/finish/mind/avoid/suggest/practice/consider。
两者皆可但意义不同：remember/forget/regret/stop/try。
examples: I enjoy reading novels.
Remember to lock the door.

questions.stem: She enjoys ___ to classical music.
questions.explain: enjoy + doing。

questions.stem: Remember ___ the door when you leave.
questions.explain: remember to do 记得去做。

questions.stem: He avoided ___ the same mistake.
questions.explain: avoid + doing。

questions.stem: They stopped ___ when the teacher came in.
questions.explain: stop doing 停止做某事。

questions.stem: I look forward to ___ from you.
questions.explain: look forward to doing。

questions.stem: It took him two hours ___ the work.
questions.explain: It takes sb time to do。

topics.title: 分词作状语与定语
rules: 现在分词：主动/进行；过去分词：被动/完成。
逻辑主语须与句子主语一致。
分词短语可表时间、原因、条件、伴随。
examples: Seeing the police, he ran away.
Given more time, we could do better.

questions.stem: ___ from the hill, the city looks beautiful.
questions.explain: city 被看 → 过去分词 Seen。

questions.stem: ___ the truth, he felt relieved.
questions.explain: 他被告知 → Told。

questions.stem: ___ the project, they went home early.
questions.explain: 主动且先于主句 → Having finished。

topics.title: 独立主格结构
rules: 结构：名词/代词 + 分词/不定式/形容词/介词短语。
逻辑主语与句子主语不同时使用。
表时间、原因、条件、伴随。
examples: Weather permitting, we will go hiking.
The work done, they went home.

questions.stem: All things ___, the plan is workable.
questions.explain: things 被考虑 → considered。

questions.stem: He sat there, his eyes ___ on the screen.
questions.explain: eyes 被盯住 → fixed。

questions.stem: Time ___, we will finish on schedule.
questions.explain: time 允许 → permitting。

topics.title: 部分倒装与全部倒装
rules: 否定词前置：never/seldom/hardly/not only → 部分倒装。
only + 状语前置 → 部分倒装。
地点状语前置 + 不及物动词 → 全部倒装（Here comes…）。
examples: Never have I seen such a mess.
Only then did he realize his mistake.

questions.stem: Not until midnight ___ writing.
questions.explain: Not until 前置 → 部分倒装。

questions.stem: Hardly ___ when the power went off.
questions.explain: Hardly…when 用过去完成时倒装。

questions.stem: Only after the meeting ___ the truth.
questions.explain: only + 状语 → 倒装。

topics.title: 强调句与省略
rules: 强调句：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余。
去掉 It is/was…that 句子仍完整。
状语从句省略：When (he was) young…；if necessary 等。
examples: It was yesterday that I met her.
If (it is) necessary, call me.

questions.stem: It was in the library ___ I lost my wallet.
questions.explain: 强调句型一律用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until 1990 ___ the law was passed.
questions.explain: 强调 not until…that。

questions.stem: ___ in difficulty, he never gave up.
questions.explain: 从句不可倒装为主谓错序。

topics.title: 主谓一致
rules: 就近原则：either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also。
就远原则：as well as / together with / along with 不影响主语数。
不定代词 everyone/each/every 作主语 → 单数；people/police → 复数。
examples: Neither he nor I am wrong.
The teacher as well as the students is coming.

questions.stem: Each of the students ___ a textbook.
questions.explain: each of + 复数 → 谓语单数。

questions.stem: The teacher, along with his students, ___ going to visit the museum.
questions.explain: along with 就远，谓语随 teacher。

questions.stem: Neither the boys nor their father ___ at home.
questions.explain: 就近：father 单数 → is。

questions.stem: The police ___ looking for the suspect.
questions.explain: police 集合名词作复数。

questions.stem: Bread and butter ___ his usual breakfast.
questions.explain: 视为整体 → 单数。

questions.stem: More than one student ___ finished the task.
questions.explain: more than one + 单数。

topics.title: 冠词用法
rules: a/an：首次提到、泛指一类；an + 元音音素。
the：特指、序数词、最高级、独一无二、乐器。
零冠词：三餐/球类/学科前（play football / study English）。
examples: He is an honest boy.
The sun rises in the east.

questions.stem: He plays ___ piano every evening.
questions.explain: 乐器前加 the。

questions.stem: She is ___ university student.
questions.explain: university 音标 /juː/ → a。

questions.stem: I had ___ breakfast at seven.
questions.explain: 三餐前零冠词。

questions.stem: ___ second chapter is more difficult.
questions.explain: 序数词前用 the。

topics.title: 比较级与最高级
rules: 比较级 + than；the + 最高级 + 范围。
倍数表达：A is three times as big as B / bigger than B / the size of B。
no more than / not more than / no less than 含义区别。
examples: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
He is by far the best student.

questions.stem: This bridge is ___ than that one.
questions.explain: than → 比较级。

questions.stem: He is ___ tallest boy in his class.
questions.explain: 最高级前加 the。

questions.stem: The hall is three times ___ our classroom.
questions.explain: 倍数 + as…as。

topics.title: 情态动词表推测
rules: must + do：一定（肯定推测）；can't + do：不可能。
may/might + do：可能。
must have done：过去一定；can't have done：过去不可能。
examples: He must be at home; the light is on.
He can't have finished so soon.

questions.stem: She ___ be in the office — her car is outside.
questions.explain: 肯定证据 → must。

questions.stem: He ___ have missed the bus; he left home very early.
questions.explain: 过去不可能 → can't have done。

questions.stem: You ___ have told me earlier — now it's too late.
questions.explain: should have done 本该做却没做。

topics.title: need / dare / used to / ought to
rules: need：情态动词（needn't do）或实义动词（need to do）。
used to do 过去常常；be used to doing 习惯于。
ought to = should，语气稍正式。
examples: You needn't worry.
He used to smoke heavily.

questions.stem: You ___ water the flowers; it is going to rain.
questions.explain: 情态动词 needn't + 原形。

questions.stem: He is used to ___ up early.
questions.explain: be used to doing 习惯于。

questions.stem: She ___ live in the countryside, but now she lives in the city.
questions.explain: used to do 过去常常。

topics.title: 并列连词与逻辑关系
rules: and/both…and；or/either…or；but/yet/however。
for 表原因（不放句首）；so 表结果；therefore 正式因此。
not only…but also 并列须对称。
examples: Not only did he apologize, but he also paid for the damage.

questions.stem: He was tired, ___ he continued working.
questions.explain: 转折 but。

questions.stem: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot his homework.
questions.explain: not only 置前倒装。

questions.stem: You must hurry, ___ you will miss the flight.
questions.explain: 否则 → or。

topics.title: 从属连词辨析
rules: while 表对比/虽然；as 表当…时/因为/正如。
since 既然/自从；now that 既然。
in order that / so that 目的。
examples: While I understand your point, I disagree.
Now that you are here, let's begin.

questions.stem: ___ you have finished, you may leave.
questions.explain: 既然 → Now that。

questions.stem: He spoke loudly ___ everyone could hear him.
questions.explain: 目的 → so that。

questions.stem: ___ I admit the problem, I don't think it serious.
questions.explain: while 表让步/对比。

topics.title: 代词与指代
rules: it 指同一物；one 指同类中的一个；that 指上文提到的同类（特指）。
another / the other / others / the others。
反身代词：enjoy oneself / by oneself。
examples: I lost my pen; I'll buy a new one.
I don't like this hat. Show me another.

questions.stem: My phone is old; I want to buy a new ___.
questions.explain: 同类另一个 → one。

questions.stem: Of the three books, two are mine, ___ is his.
questions.explain: 两者中另一个 → the other。

questions.stem: The weather in Beijing is much colder than ___ in Shanghai.
questions.explain: 比较中指代不可数/可数名词 → that。

topics.title: would rather / it's time / prefer
rules: would rather (that) + 过去式（现在）/ 过去完成时（过去）。
It's (high) time + 过去式。
prefer A to B / prefer doing to doing / would rather A than B。
examples: I would rather you stayed at home.
It's high time we left.

questions.stem: I would rather you ___ me the truth yesterday.
questions.explain: 过去 → had told。

questions.stem: It's time we ___ a decision.
questions.explain: It's time + 过去式。

questions.stem: I prefer reading ___ watching TV.
questions.explain: prefer A to B。

topics.title: 特殊句型与固定搭配
rules: It is + adj + of/for sb to do（性格用 of，事情用 for）。
too…to / enough to / so…that。
there be / there exist / there remains。
examples: It is kind of you to help.
There remains one problem.

questions.stem: It is important ___ us to protect the environment.
questions.explain: important 描述事 → for。

questions.stem: It is careless ___ you to make such a mistake.
questions.explain: careless 描述人 → of。

questions.stem: ___ no need to worry about the exam.
questions.explain: There is no need to do。

topics.title: 介词与介词短语
rules: 时间：at night / on Monday / in 2020。
固定：be good at / be interested in / depend on / consist of。
易混：in time 及时 / on time 准时；in front of 前方 / in the front of 前部。
examples: He is good at mathematics.
The train arrived on time.

questions.stem: We are proud ___ our country.
questions.explain: be proud of。

questions.stem: The book consists ___ ten chapters.
questions.explain: consist of。

questions.stem: The teacher stood ___ the classroom facing the students.
questions.explain: 在教室前部（内部）→ in the front of。

questions.stem: He arrived ___ the morning of May 1st.
questions.explain: 具体某天早晨用 on。

questions.stem: She is afraid ___ speaking in public.
questions.explain: be afraid of doing。

topics.title: 形容词与副词语序
rules: 多个形容词：限定+描绘+大小+形状+年龄+颜色+国籍+材料。
enough 修饰形容词时后置（old enough）。
副词位置：频率副词在 be/情态/助动后，实义动词前。
examples: a beautiful small old Chinese wooden chair
He often arrives late.
